## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

EndOfRaceViewModel — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/endofrace/EndOfRaceViewModel.kt

## Trigger

Building the end-of-race page's state from the finished race, in
computeState — observed

## Today

`Race.completion` (a `RaceCompletion` of `COMPLETE` or `INCOMPLETE`,
set by `RaceRecordingRepository.stopRace` when a race is stopped
before segment 30 closes) is never read in `computeState`.
`EndOfRaceUiState` carries no field to say a race is incomplete, and
`WatchStringResources.End` defines only `finish` — no message key
exists for an incomplete race, and `strings.xml` carries none either.

## Expected

`computeState` reads `finalRace.completion`; when it is `INCOMPLETE`,
`EndOfRaceUiState` carries that fact and `EndOfRaceScreen` renders a
dedicated message, drawn from a new string resource, stating the race
is incomplete.
